links.outcome: Performance of classical ML versus prompt-based and fine-tuned foundation models on medical classification
links.effect: Classical ML (LR, LightGBM, ResNet-50) achieved best overall performance across most tasks; Gemini 2.5 zero-shot performed poorly on text tasks, and LoRA-tuned Gemma performed worst across all experiments.
links.quote: According to our results, traditional machine learning (ML) models set a high standard by consistently achieving the best overall performance across most medical categorization tasks.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study comparing classical ML with prompt-based and fine-tuned LLMs/VLMs across medical text and imaging datasets without testing a deployment practice.
